schema.description: One session of exercise, shaped as an IEEE 1752 physical-activity-1.0 payload, from four sources. Two extractors write a records file: scripts/extract-technogym-json.py for Technogym mywellness indoor sessions (rower and stair climber) and scripts/extract-strong-csv.py for Strong workouts. The anam_garmin importer sends each session a Garmin watch recorded, read from its activity FIT file. The anam_concept2 importer sends each workout the Concept2 Logbook holds, read from its API: the monitor's result as ErgData synced it, splits or intervals and every stroke included, or a result entered by hand on the web, which carries totals only. Sessions from different sources can overlap, each a device's own account: a Garmin Cardio session often spans the Technogym machine sessions done during it, and the watch and the rower each record a row, so a sum across sources counts that time twice. Measures IEEE has no field for sit beside it in snake_case; values are the source's own, apart from the start time, activity name and Strong's capped duration, which the extractor or importer derives.

activity_name.description: The IEEE 1752 activity name, chosen by the extractor: rowing.machine for a Technogym session with a rowing distance, stair_climbing.machine for one with floors, strength_training for every Strong workout. For Garmin, the importer maps the FIT sport and sub-sport: walking to walking, running on a treadmill to running.treadmill, indoor rowing to rowing.machine, cardio training to other (Google Fit has no general cardio), and any pair it has no mapping for to unknown. fit_sport and fit_sub_sport keep what the watch wrote. For Concept2, the importer maps the result's type: rower to rowing.machine, bike to biking.stationary, water to rowing, and any other erg (skierg, dynamic, slides, paddle, snow, multierg) to other; erg_type keeps what the Logbook wrote.

average_cadence.description: Average stroke rate, as an IEEE 1752 cadence: Technogym's AvgSpm, Concept2's stroke_rate. Technogym and Concept2 only.

unit.description: Always "strokes/min", set by the extractor or importer.

value.description: The source's average stroke rate, as reported.

avg_hr_bpm.description: Average heart rate in beats per minute: Technogym's AvgHr, Garmin's session avg_heart_rate, Concept2's heart_rate.average, which the importer leaves out when it reads zero, the monitor's figure for no heart rate belt.

avg_peak_force.description: Technogym's AvgPeakForce, as reported. A single rowing session in the export carries it, reading zero, so its meaning and unit are not settled by the source. Technogym only.

avg_power_w.description: Average power in watts: Technogym's AvgPower, Garmin's session avg_power.

base_movement_quantity.description: The stroke count, as an IEEE 1752 movement count: Technogym's IsoReps, Garmin's session total_strokes, Concept2's stroke_count. Rowing sessions only: the stair climber reports no IsoReps.

unit.description: Always "strokes", set by the extractor or importer.

value.description: The source's stroke count, as reported.

calories_consumption.description: Technogym's CaloriesConsumption, the session's energy rate in kcal per hour: wherever it appears it equals Calories divided by the duration in hours. Technogym only.

distance.description: Distance covered in metres: Technogym's RowingDistance, metres rowed; Garmin's session total_distance, left out when the watch reports zero, as it does for a session that measures no distance; Concept2's distance.

unit.description: Always "m", set by the extractor or importer.

cumulative_elevation_gain.description: Total ascent in metres, as an IEEE 1752 elevation gain: Garmin's session total_ascent. Garmin only, on sessions that record altitude.

comments.description: Concept2's comments on the result, verbatim, as entered in the Logbook. Concept2 only, absent when empty.

descent_m.description: Garmin's session total_descent, total descent in metres. Garmin only, on sessions that record altitude.

drag_factor.description: The rower's drag setting, as reported: Technogym's DragFactor, Concept2's drag_factor. Technogym and Concept2 only.

drive_perc.description: Technogym's DrivePerc, as reported. A single rowing session in the export carries it, reading zero, so its meaning and unit are not settled by the source. Technogym only.

duration.description: The session's net duration in seconds. Technogym's Duration, the same figure the interval's duration holds; Garmin's session total_timer_time, which leaves out time the timer was paused, so it can be shorter than the interval; Concept2's time, which the Logbook gives in tenths of a second and the importer writes in seconds, the same figure the interval's duration holds.

unit.description: Always "sec", set by the extractor or importer.

ending_hr_bpm.description: Concept2's heart_rate.ending, beats per minute at the end of the workout. Concept2 only, left out when it reads zero.

erg_type.description: Concept2's type, the erg the result was rowed on as the Logbook names it: rower, skierg, bike, dynamic, slides, paddle, water, snow or multierg. Concept2 only.

duration_capped.description: True when Strong's reported duration was zero or below, or over 3 hours, so the interval's duration was set to 3 hours by the extractor (Matt's rule). Strong only; absent otherwise.

effective_time_frame.description: When the session happened, as an IEEE 1752 time interval.

duration.description: The session's length in seconds. Technogym's Duration; for Strong, its reported duration, or 3 hours when duration_capped; for Garmin, the session's total_elapsed_time, start to stop with pauses included; for Concept2, the result's time in seconds, the work time without the rest between intervals.

value.description: Seconds, a whole or decimal number.

start_date_time.description: The start, ISO 8601 with offset, to the second. Derived by the extractor: for Technogym, the export's `on` (the session's end) minus its Duration; for Strong, its "Date" column read as Sydney time, so a workout logged abroad is placed as if at home; for Garmin, the FIT session's start_time, a true UTC instant written with Z; for Concept2, the result's date_utc (the monitor's end of workout) minus its time, a UTC instant written with Z, or, for a result entered on the web, which has no date_utc and a date at midnight, that date as Sydney midnight, and start_time_known says which. This is the fact time.

exercises.description: The workout's exercise names in the order Strong first lists them, from the "Exercise Name" column. Strong only.

facility.description: Technogym's facility id, an opaque identifier for the site whose machine logged the session. It repeats on every session at one site, and the export does not name the site. Technogym only.

fit_sport.description: The FIT session's sport, as the Garmin FIT SDK names it, or its number when the SDK has no name for it ("54" is the watch's Safety profile). Garmin only.

fit_sub_sport.description: The FIT session's sub-sport, as the Garmin FIT SDK names it, or its number when the SDK has no name for it. Garmin only.

floors.description: Technogym's Floors, floors climbed on the stair climber, as reported. Technogym only.

id.description: The records row's id. Technogym sessions are technogym: and the export's `on` timestamp, verbatim; Strong workouts are strong:session: and the workout's start. Garmin sessions are not records rows: garmin:session: and the session's UTC start. Nor are Concept2 workouts: concept2:session: and the Logbook's result id.

kcal_burned.description: Energy burned in kcal: Technogym's Calories, Garmin's session total_calories, Concept2's calories_total.

unit.description: Always "kcal", set by the extractor or importer.

level.description: Technogym's Level, the machine's resistance level, as reported. A split's level is a whole number; the session's can be fractional, a figure Technogym computes that is close to, but not exactly, the mean of its splits' levels. Technogym only.

logbook_date.description: Concept2's date, verbatim: the monitor's end of workout as a local wall clock time, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS", or the day with a midnight time for a result entered on the web. Concept2 only.

logbook_source.description: Concept2's source, how the result reached the Logbook: "ErgData Android", "ErgData iOS", "Concept2 Utility" or "Web" for one entered by hand. Concept2 only.

logbook_timezone.description: Concept2's timezone, the IANA zone logbook_date is in. Concept2 only, absent on a result entered on the web, where the Logbook holds none.

max_hr_bpm.description: Peak heart rate in beats per minute: Technogym's MaxHr, Garmin's session max_heart_rate, Concept2's heart_rate.max, which the importer leaves out when it reads zero, as the monitor writes it even on a result whose splits carry a maximum.

max_power_w.description: Peak power in watts: Technogym's MaxPower, Garmin's session max_power.

max_spm.description: Technogym's MaxSpm, peak stroke rate in strokes per minute. Technogym only.

mets.description: Technogym's Mets, which despite the name holds MET-minutes: on every session with both, it equals mets_min times the session's minutes. The extractor has left it out since version 2 (Matt: a bespoke measure), so only facets written by version 1 carry it, each since superseded by a version without it. Technogym only. Checked on the live record, 2026-10-10: no live facet carries it; only the superseded extractor v1 versions did.

mets_min.description: Technogym's MetsMin, which despite the name holds the session's MET rate, mets divided by the session's minutes; on stair climber sessions vo2 is exactly 3.5 times it. The extractor has left it out since version 2, so only facets written by version 1 carry it, each since superseded by a version without it. Technogym only. Checked on the live record, 2026-10-10: no live facet carries it; only the superseded extractor v1 versions did.

move.description: Technogym's Move, its own activity score in what Technogym calls MOVEs, as reported. Technogym does not say how it is computed, and it tracks neither calories nor duration alone. Technogym only.

ph_id.description: Technogym's phId, an opaque identifier kept as written. It is not unique per session: every session done as the same workout shares one (sessions under a phId share a target distance or time), and the export does not name the workouts. Technogym only.

ranked.description: Concept2's ranked, whether the result counts in the Logbook's rankings. Concept2 only.

rest_distance_m.description: Concept2's rest_distance, metres rowed during the rests of an interval workout. Concept2 interval workouts only.

rest_time_sec.description: Concept2's rest_time, the rest between the intervals of an interval workout in seconds, given by the Logbook in tenths of a second. Concept2 interval workouts only.

reported_duration_sec.description: Strong's "Duration (sec)" for the workout, always kept as reported, even when it is unusable. Strong only.

sets.description: Every row of the Strong workout in file order, set by set, rest timers and notes included. Strong only.

items.description: One Strong CSV row, minus the workout-level columns.

rpe.description: The "RPE" column, the rating of perceived exertion as logged.

seconds.description: The "Seconds" column, a timed set's length in seconds.

set.description: The "Set Order" column as text: a set number, or a marker such as "Rest Timer" or "Note" for rows that are not sets.

source.description: Which app the session came from, written by the extractor or importer: "Technogym mywellness", "Strong", "Garmin" or "Concept2 Logbook".

source_time.description: How the session's start was read (card 197). Garmin: value is the FIT start_time, UTC by the format's definition (basis source). Concept2 and records do not write it yet, so it is not required.

value.description: The fact time as the source supplied it, as text and never rewritten: a date, a wall clock, an RFC 3339 string, or an epoch as its digits.

zone.description: The zone value is read in, and nothing else: an IANA name when one is known, UTC for a value that is UTC, else a fixed offset +HH:MM or -HH:MM. The gate refuses a name that is no zone.

basis.description: Who decided the zone. source: the source supplied it with the value, or the value is UTC by the source's own definition. configuration: a setting a person made for this source names it. assumption: the importer or writer chose it, with nothing behind it but its own default or the Definition's zone, and logged that it did.

sport_profile.description: The name of the activity profile on the watch that recorded the session, Garmin's sport_profile_name, such as Cardio, Walk or Safety. Garmin only.

split_500m_sec.description: Technogym's RowingSplit, pace per 500 m in seconds. Technogym only.

splits.description: Per-split measures for the session, in the source's order: Technogym's splits from the export; Concept2's workout splits, or its intervals for an interval workout, each with the rest that followed it. Technogym and Concept2 only. A Technogym split carries power and level; a Concept2 split carries heart rate and watt-minutes.

items.description: One split, each measure a plain number.

avg_hr_bpm.description: Average heart rate for the split, beats per minute: Technogym's AvgHr, Concept2's heart_rate.average.

avg_power_w.description: AvgPower for the split, watts. Technogym only.

avg_spm.description: Average stroke rate for the split, strokes per minute: Technogym's AvgSpm, Concept2's stroke_rate.

distance_m.description: Distance for the split, metres: Technogym's RowingDistance, Concept2's distance.

duration_sec.description: Duration of the split, seconds; Concept2's time, given in tenths of a second, is written in seconds.

ending_hr_bpm.description: Concept2's heart_rate.ending for the split, beats per minute at its end. Concept2 only, left out when it reads zero.

kcal.description: Calories for the split, kcal: Technogym's Calories, Concept2's calories_total.

level.description: Level for the split, the machine's resistance level. Technogym only.

max_hr_bpm.description: Concept2's heart_rate.max for the split, beats per minute. Concept2 only, left out when it reads zero.

max_power_w.description: MaxPower for the split, watts. Technogym only.

max_spm.description: MaxSpm for the split, strokes per minute. Technogym only.

min_hr_bpm.description: Concept2's heart_rate.min for the split, beats per minute. Concept2 only, left out when it reads zero.

position.description: The split's position in the session, from 1: the export's `pos` for Technogym, the array's order for Concept2.

rest_hr_bpm.description: Concept2's heart_rate.rest, beats per minute at the end of the rest after an interval. Concept2 intervals only, left out when it reads zero.

rest_time_sec.description: Concept2's rest_time for an interval, the rest that followed it in seconds. Concept2 intervals only.

split_500m_sec.description: RowingSplit for the split, seconds per 500 m. Technogym only.

strokes.description: IsoReps for the split, a stroke count. Technogym only.

watt_minutes.description: Concept2's wattminutes_total for the split, work done in watt-minutes. Concept2 only.

start_time_known.description: Whether the start is the monitor's: true for a Concept2 result ErgData synced, false for one entered on the web, whose start is the day it names at Sydney midnight. Concept2 only.

stroke_series.description: Every stroke of the workout as the monitor recorded it, in order: Concept2's stroke data for the result, each figure converted by the importer from the Logbook's units. Concept2 only, on results that carry stroke data.

items.description: One stroke, from the Logbook's t (tenths of a second), d (decimetres), p (tenths of a second per 500 m), spm and hr.

distance_m.description: Distance rowed so far at this stroke, metres: the Logbook's d, decimetres, divided by 10.

hr_bpm.description: Heart rate at this stroke, beats per minute: the Logbook's hr, left out when it reads zero.

pace_500m_sec.description: Pace at this stroke, seconds per 500 m: the Logbook's p, tenths of a second, divided by 10.

spm.description: Stroke rate at this stroke, strokes per minute: the Logbook's spm.

time_sec.description: Elapsed work time at this stroke, seconds: the Logbook's t, tenths of a second, divided by 10.

training_effect_aerobic.description: Garmin's session total_training_effect, its aerobic training effect on a 0 to 5 scale, computed by the watch. Garmin only.

training_effect_anaerobic.description: Garmin's session total_anaerobic_training_effect, its anaerobic training effect on a 0 to 5 scale, computed by the watch. Garmin only.

training_load.description: Garmin's session training_load_peak, the training load the watch computes for the session; Garmin does not publish how. Garmin only.

user_weight_kg.description: Technogym's UserWeight, the body weight entered on the machine, in kilograms. Technogym only.

verified.description: Concept2's verified, whether the monitor sent the result (true) or a person entered it (false). Concept2 only.

vo2.description: Technogym's Vo2, estimated oxygen uptake in ml/kg/min: it is exactly 3.5 times the session's MET rate (1 MET = 3.5 ml/kg/min), so it is derived, not measured. The export has it on stair climber sessions only. Technogym only.

watt_minutes.description: Concept2's wattminutes_total, the work done in watt-minutes as the monitor computed it. Concept2 only.

weight_class.description: Concept2's weight_class, the Logbook's weight class for the result: "H" (heavyweight) or "L" (lightweight). Concept2 only.

workout_notes.description: The workout's distinct "Workout Notes" values, sorted. Strong only.

workout_type.description: Concept2's workout_type, the monitor's workout mode as the Logbook names it, such as JustRow, FixedDistanceSplits, FixedTimeSplits, FixedDistanceInterval, FixedTimeInterval or VariableInterval, or unknown for a result entered on the web. Concept2 only.
